about.title: A small studio, on purpose
about.lead: We started DotGrey in 2019 because we kept watching good work get diluted on its way from the pitch room to the people actually building it.
storyParagraphs: Between us we had spent years inside network agencies and in-house product teams. Both taught the same lesson from opposite directions: the distance between the person who understands the problem and the person who solves it is where quality goes to die.
So we built the studio around removing that distance. The designer in the pitch is the designer on the file. The engineer who scoped the build is the one who ships it.
Seven years and 320-odd projects later we are eighteen people across Dhaka and four time zones, and the rule has not changed.

services.title: What we do
services.lead: Six services, one team. Most engagements use two or three of them together, which is rather the point.
services.processTitle: A process you can plan around

process.title: Discover
process.body: A workshop, an audit and a written brief we both agree on before anything starts.

process.title: Design
process.body: Concepts, refinement and a system — reviewed weekly, never sprung on you at the end.

process.title: Build
process.body: Engineering from day one of design handoff, with a preview deploy you can click.

process.title: Launch
process.body: Migration, measurement and thirty days of support while it settles.

team.title: The people doing the work
team.lead: No account layer, no handoff to a junior team. Everyone here is on the tools.
team.hiringBody: open roles across design, engineering and production.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.lead: Retainers are billed monthly with no minimum term. Fixed-scope projects are quoted up front. Either way, you know the number before we start.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: If the answer you need is not here, ask us directly — we reply within one working day.
faq.stillBody: Book fifteen minutes and ask them. No deck, no pitch.

careers.title: Work with us
careers.lead: We hire slowly and keep teams small. That means more ownership, fewer meetings, and your name actually attached to the work.
whyParagraphs: There is no layer between you and the client. You will present your own work, hear the feedback first-hand, and decide how to act on it. That is uncomfortable for about a month and then it is the only way you want to work.
We keep project counts low on purpose, so nobody is spread across six things at once. When something ships badly we look at the process, not the person.
careers.applyBody: We read every application and reply either way, usually within a week.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.lead: Tell us what you are building and when you need it. We reply within one working day — usually with questions rather than a proposal.
